A1: Introduce yourself in two or three sentences.
What do you usually eat for breakfast?
Describe one room in your home.
What do you like to do on Sundays?
Tell me about an animal you like.
A2: Tell me about your last trip. Where did you go and what did you do?
Explain how to get from your home to a nearby shop.
What are you going to do next weekend, and why?
Describe a meal you can prepare. Give two steps.
Compare the weather in two seasons you know.
B1: Describe a skill you learned recently. What helped you improve?
A friend wants to study English every day. Give them two practical suggestions.
Would you prefer to work at home or in an office? Explain your choice.
Tell me about a book or film you would recommend and why.
Describe a problem you solved and what you would do differently next time.
B2: Should mobile phones be allowed in lessons? Present an argument and a counterargument.
Explain a trade-off between public transport and driving.
What makes an online source reliable? Give an example.
Should employers value experience or formal qualifications more? Defend a balanced view.
Explain how a city could reduce waste without making life harder for residents.
C1: Discuss whether efficiency is always the best criterion for evaluating public services.
Explain how one could distinguish correlation from causation in a classroom study.
Argue how an institution should balance accessibility with academic standards.
Evaluate one advantage and one limitation of remote collaboration.
Explain how language choices can influence the way a public debate is framed.
C2: When can an apparently neutral benchmark perpetuate an existing bias? Develop an example and a counterexample.
Distinguish uncertainty from ambiguity in a policy decision and explain why it matters.
Assess whether transparency is sufficient to establish institutional trust.
Present and respond to a strong objection to the claim that automation makes education fairer.
Explain how the same evidence might legitimately support competing interpretations in a research debate.

yds: In the sentence ‘The sample was **tiny**’, which word is closest in meaning to tiny?
Tiny bu bağlamda çok küçük demektir. Small en yakın seçenektir.
The road was flooded, _____ the bus took a different route.
Otobüsün rotasını değiştirmesi su baskınının sonucudur. So sonuç bildirir.
The team weighed each sample twice to check the _____ of its measurements.
Ölçümleri kontrol ederken ağırlığı iki kez ölçmek doğrulukla ilgilidir.
The library extended its opening hours during exam week. As a result, students had more time to _____ for their exams.
Prepare for an exam, bir sınava hazırlanmak anlamına gelir.
The policy will **allow** students to borrow more books. Which word can replace allow?
Allow ve permit, bu cümlede izin vermek anlamındadır.
Take a bottle of water _____ you get thirsty on the walk.
In case, gerçekleşmesi olası bir duruma karşı önlem almayı anlatır.
To open an account, you need to _____ proof of your address.
Provide proof, kanıt veya belge sunmak anlamına gelir.
The machine shuts down automatically when it overheats. This feature helps to _____ damage to the motor.
Otomatik kapanma motorun hasar görmesini önler.
The council **postponed** the vote until Tuesday. Which phrase has the same meaning?
Postpone ve put off, planlanan bir eylemi ileri tarihe bırakmaktır.
_____ the first report focused on costs, the second examined environmental effects.
Whereas iki ayrı odak arasında karşıtlık kurar.
Because the error affected every measurement in the same way, it was considered _____.
Her ölçümde aynı yönde oluşan hata sistematik hatadır.
The original estimate relied on a very small sample. The researchers then doubled the sample size in order to _____ the uncertainty of the result.
Daha büyük örneklem, aynı yöntemle ölçüldüğünde örneklem kaynaklı belirsizliği azaltabilir.
The park will remain open _____ the wind does not reach dangerous speeds.
Belirtilen durum parkın açık kalmasının koşuludur.
The report fails to _____ its central claim with evidence.
Substantiate a claim, iddiayı kanıtla temellendirmek anlamına gelir.
Adoption of the method was **gradual**. Which term has the closest meaning?
Gradual ve incremental, değişimin adım adım gerçekleştiğini ifade eder.
The author used multiple sources that were collected independently. The agreement among them made the conclusion more _____.
Bağımsız kaynakların uyumu sonucu daha inandırıcı kılar.
The error **vitiated** the agreement. Which word best matches vitiated?
Vitiate bu kullanımda bir anlaşmanın geçerliliğini bozmak anlamına gelir.
The two methods estimate the same quantity. _____, they rely on very different assumptions.
İkinci cümle ilk cümleye rağmen geçerli olan bir farkı belirtir.
The independent observations _____ the researchers' account of what occurred.
Corroborate, bağımsız kanıtla bir açıklamayı desteklemek demektir.
The historical sources disagree about the cause of the strike. Their accounts cannot be reconciled unless the different meanings of ‘strike’ in the records are _____.
Disambiguate, bir terimin hangi anlamıyla kullanıldığını açıklığa kavuşturmaktır.
The new controls _____ the need to repeat the experiment; nothing further was required.
Obviate the need, bir gerekliliği ortadan kaldırmaktır.
The inference rests on a **tenuous** link. Which word comes closest to tenuous?
Tenuous link, zayıf ve sağlam temellendirilmemiş bir bağlantıdır.
The team tried to _____ an equipment fault as a possible explanation.
Rule out, bir olasılığı değerlendirme dışı bırakmak anlamındadır.
The authors state that the findings apply only within the range of their data. They caution readers against _____ the results beyond that range.
Extrapolate, gözlenmiş veri aralığının dışına bir sonuç veya tahmin taşımaktır.
